description: Work-order rules (card M4-05, P Part 4 Step 4.5).

open_posterior.ref: P Step 4.5: a hypothesis with posterior >= 0.7 opens a work order

time_to_limit_open_s.ref: a trend predicted to reach its limit within 1 h opens a work order

stable_evaluations.ref: the same hypothesis must lead with posterior >= open_posterior on this many consecutive isolation evaluations (about 30 s on the 5-tick cadence) before a work order opens: early, unsettled rankings do not create orders
